UI design | 4 screens in order

Case study

Brief
A personal project: I recreated a streaming-app interface with my own design choices.
My work

Illustrator

Logos and posters | 3 pieces

Case study

AnnaData logo

Brief
A logo for a fertilizer and machinery shop, designed so farmers understand it at a glance.
Idea
A leaf grows inside the A for crops and fertilizer. The D has a tyre-like shape for tractors and machinery.
Test
I researched the idea, then showed the logo to 10 farmers. They easily said it looks like a farmer shop for pesticides and tractor-related items.
Learned
Aesthetic logos are not my style. I want to make logos that anyone can understand quickly, even people with little formal education.

Case study

Raaga fashion brand logo

Brief
A logo for an online clothing startup.
Idea
A mannequin sits inside the R. People see mannequins in malls and shops every day, so the meaning is clear even without reading the name.
Style
Stylish, aesthetic fonts together with the mannequin, to attract Gen Z and young customers.
